title: Rosefield Tour Bus
passage:
Rosefield Tour Bus

Times
May to October: 8 a.m. to 7 p.m. every day
November to April: 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. every day
Regular times may change on national holidays. Check www.rosefieldbuses.org for more information.

Ticket fees
West Line: $18.50 per person; under 12: $10
East Line: $21.50 per person; under 12: $12
Circle Line — express service: $24.50 per adult and $14.00 for youth under 18

Tickets bought on the internet are 10–15% cheaper. Save an extra 10% on your ticket price for a both-lines ticket to use both the West and East lines.

Other things to know
Buses leave every 45 minutes from King Station.
West Line — total travel time: 45 minutes
East Line — total travel time: 75 minutes
Priority seats are marked in green.
Due to traffic, buses will not stop at the sports ground on the day of a game.
